high_level_description: stc brand style, a daytime photograph of a modern tech exhibition venue entrance branded 'VELOCITY'.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A modern architectural building with a curved white exterior, geometric patterns, and circular cutouts, set on a light gray tiled plaza with people walking near the entrance.

elements.desc: A curved white overhang and glass doors marking the venue entrance.
Dark-colored promotional banners on the left side of the facade, and a digital display showing promotional images of electronic devices including headphones and tablets.
Large metallic 3D letters mounted on the plaza spelling out the venue name.
A large digital display board above the entrance showing the event name in white text against a blue and purple gradient.
